question: Which compound did FTIR suggest forms as a unique component of the 300 °C–300 °C multilayer crystal, and in what temperature range does TGA show the extra mass-loss step attributed to it?
rendered:
The compound that FTIR suggested forms as a unique component of the 300 °C–300 °C multilayer crystal is cyanuric acid (CYA).

TGA shows the extra mass-loss step attributed to CYA in the 200–250 °C range.
